Get a sub-product of a multi-product datasource

Source: R/datasources.R
get_datasource_product.Rd

Several datasources (e.g. the Theia products forms_t, theia_soil, theia_snow) bundle more than one raster product under a products block — for forms_t, the height, volume and biomass sub-products. This helper returns the metadata of one named sub-product (resolution, unit, value range, conversion notes), so a caller can pick the right product and apply any documented unit conversion before feeding it to an indicator.

Usage

get_datasource_product(source_key, product, country = "FR")

Arguments

source_key

Character. The datasource key (e.g., "forms_t").

product

Character. The sub-product name (e.g., "height").

country

Character. ISO country code. Default "FR".

Value

A list with the sub-product configuration.

Examples

h <- get_datasource_product("forms_t", "height", "FR")
h$unit          # "cm"
#> [1] "cm"
h$resolution_m  # 10
#> [1] 10
